decisions.reason: Locates Pet.tsx:19-21 reads of partial/runningCalls/turnEnds and explains the two-step pattern: temporary views.get('chat')?.legacy projection (A1-03 field note) then field-by-field move to useChat keyed ChatSnapshot and view timeline; not merely a 'legacy' mention.

Locates Pet.tsx:18 running selector, explains lifecycle fields are not in the legacy projection and must stay on the useSession seat (outside chat legacy), and does not claim useSession must be renamed.

Locates removed dsh-client-runtime imports (index.ts:5, Pet.tsx:6) and the package.json client.inject entry; repoints Context as ClientContext to @deepseek-ai/cordis and snapshot types to dsh-client-ui-chat, without claiming cordis exports snapshot types; explicitly defers unknown exact snapshot field names to target-tag exports.

Locates the scoped ctx.inject(['slots','conversation'], scope => scope.slots.register(...)) in index.ts, explains the ordering/strict-injection rationale, keeps the slot name and resident lifetime, and covers Context augmentation via owning-package type-only imports (ui-conversation SlotMap, locale).

Ties the located snapshot/lifecycle/slot changes to DSH-0.1.2-A1-03 (plus A1-25 as the package-removal card, with concrete mapping), and §2's table separates the temporary legacy projection from immediate type/inject/manifest/id changes.
